predefined_info.altitude: Elevation (m) from the [NASA SRTM 30 m](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/USGS_SRTMGL1_003) digital elevation model, clipped to your AOI. Continuous.
predefined_info.slope: Terrain slope (degrees) computed from the [NASA SRTM 30 m](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/USGS_SRTMGL1_003) elevation with Earth Engine's `ee.Terrain.slope`. Continuous.
predefined_info.protected_area: Binary mask (1 = inside a protected area) built by rasterizing the designated/inscribed/established/proposed polygons of the [WDPA — World Database on Protected Areas](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/WCMC_WDPA_current_polygons).
predefined_info.rivers: Binary mask of rivers and streams from the [OSM Water Layer](https://gee-community-catalog.org/projects/osm_water/) (surface-water classes), clipped to your AOI.
predefined_info.roads: Binary mask of roads rasterized from [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/) road geometries, clipped to your AOI.
predefined_info.forest_gfc: Forest/non-forest mask (1 = forest) for the chosen year, derived from [Hansen Global Forest Change](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/UMD_hansen_global_forest_change_2024_v1_12): pixels above the tree-cover threshold in 2000 minus loss up to that year. Temporal.
predefined_info.forest_tmf: Forest/non-forest mask (1 = forest) for the chosen year from the [JRC Tropical Moist Forest](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/projects_JRC_TMF_v1_2024_AnnualChanges) annual-change product (undisturbed forest kept as forest). Temporal.
predefined_info.towns: Binary urban-area mask (1 = built-up + populated) for the nearest epoch, from [JRC GHSL](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/JRC_GHSL_P2023A_GHS_BUILT_S) population and built-surface layers. Temporal (5-year epochs).
predefined_info.subj: Categorical raster of level-2 administrative subjurisdictions from [FAO GAUL](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/FAO_GAUL_2015_level2), each zone given a distinct value. Used for JNR-style stratification.

modal.source_hint: predefined = ready-made Earth Engine layers; custom = your own raster, vector or GEE asset.
modal.custom_type_hint: LocalRasterVar = GeoTIFF on disk; GEEVar = Earth Engine asset; LocalVectorVar = vector file, rasterized during processing.
modal.custom_year_hint: Set for temporal layers so the same variable can be added per year; leave blank for static ones.
modal.custom_scale_hint: Nominal pixel size in metres used when exporting this GEE asset.
modal.custom_raster_type_hint: continuous = measured values (e.g. elevation); categorical = classes or 0/1 masks.
modal.custom_rasterization_method_hint: binary = 1 where a feature is present, 0 elsewhere; unique = one value per feature/class.
modal.error_no_predefined_selected: Select a variable from the list.
modal.error_year_required: Year is required for this variable.
